rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Biology spans molecules to the biosphere and splits into branches by organism (botany, zoology, microbiology), by level (cytology, histology, physiology, ecology) and by purpose (medicine, agriculture, biotechnology). rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Biology = Bios (life) + Logos (study) = the study of living organisms
Scope: molecule → cell → tissue → organ → organism → population → community → ecosystem → biosphere
Scientific method: Observation → Question → Hypothesis → Experiment → Data → Conclusion

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **Morphology vs anatomy:** morphology = external form; anatomy = internal organisation of tissues.  ·  **Basic vs applied:** basic asks "how does it work?"; applied asks "how can we use it?"

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: NEB expects the definition of biology, the 9-level scope, and the 7 characteristics of life.  ·  The scientific method is a favourite exam question (6 steps).

rows.label: Solved

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: **Biology is layered:** each level (molecule → biosphere) has its own questions and emergent properties — no single branch sees the whole organism.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: Scope: molecules → biosphere; fields split by organism (botany/zoology/microbiology), by level (molecular to ecosystem), by purpose (medicine/agriculture/environment).  ·  Branches: botany, zoology, microbiology, morphology, anatomy, cytology, histology, physiology, ecology, genetics, evolution, taxonomy, embryology, paleontology, molecular biology, biotechnology, parasitology.  ·  Basic research = knowledge for its own sake (DNA replication); applied = problem-solving (insulin in E. coli).

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Biology, medicine and agriculture together employ more scientists than any other natural science.

rows.label: MCQ drill
rows.text: Biology is the study of: → B  ·  The branch of biology that studies plants is: → B
